hero.description: AI-assisted 3D brain and liver surgical planning. Transform complex imaging into spatial understanding and explore risk-aware paths before the first incision.
hero.artAlt: Glowing three-dimensional brain and liver medical visualization

overview.description: A connected planning experience that helps teams move from raw scans to an informed, three-dimensional view of anatomy and surgical approach.

brain.label: 01 / Explore the brain
brain.text: Scroll to rotate a live 3D brain preview. Move your pointer to inspect its depth, contours, and a highlighted target.

transition.label: 02 / Shift your perspective
transition.text: The scene moves with you, carrying the view from neurological anatomy toward the next planning context.

liver.label: 03 / Explore the liver
liver.text: Continue scrolling to reveal the liver model and its branching structures, with a proposed trajectory shown in 3D.

experience.hint: Move your pointer to guide the view · Scroll to transition

segmentation.title: Intelligent segmentation
segmentation.text: Bring regions of interest into focus with AI-assisted delineation of anatomy and suspected lesions.

reconstruction.title: Spatial reconstruction
reconstruction.text: Explore brain and liver structures in a layered 3D context built for pre-operative review.

optimization.title: Risk-aware pathways
optimization.text: Compare potential approaches with critical structures and surgical constraints in view.

planner.description: Move between organ views and see how anatomy, risk context, and a proposed trajectory could come together in one interface.
planner.insight1Text: Review surrounding structures in relation to the target.
planner.insight2Text: Keep sensitive regions visible during route exploration.
planner.insight3Text: Assess a proposed approach from multiple perspectives.

workflow.description: A clear sequence for bringing imaging, anatomy, and path planning into one reviewable workflow.
